title: A head whose trial passed ahead of review is not trialled a second time
description: The real merge writer over a real temporary Postgres control plane and a scratch remote: an unreviewed head's trial passes and settles as kept in the same cycle whose snapshot still shows the flight's intent open. The reconcile leaves that intent alone, the kept-trial marker stays on the ledger, no second trial starts while review is pending, and the head lands on the kept result once approved — exactly one trial run.

steps.name: a kept trial survives the cycle that settled it and is run once
